Short infra feasibility note: we can support a 30-day debug-slice retention carveout via prefix-based routing to a short-retention bucket. Two implementation choices:
1) Fast path (recommended for procurement): create tenant-specific prefix + ACL that routes debug logs to a 30-day bucket. Requires a one-time infra change and ops runbook; estimate 5 business days to enable and produce evidence.
2) Longer path: fully parameterize retention windows per tenant in the control plane (product + infra work, ~8–10 weeks).

BYOK import: canonical flow is customer uploads wrapped key material to our KMS endpoint; Redwood stores an ARN referencing the wrapped key in a tenant metadata record and never logs raw key bytes. For HSM-backed customers we provide a PKCS#11-compatible transfer shim. If MedSpring requires HSM handoff, we'll need an integration window (2–3 weeks) to schedule the transfer and audit witness.

I can prepare the ops checklist and a short-runbook for the fast path; ETA: runbook + checklist by Tuesday COB.

Aditya
Principal Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference
